problem.instanceName: Name the instance, like Acme ReputeCast.
problem.language: Pick a language ReputeCast is translated into, and one of the region formats.
problem.publicURL: Use the full address people open, like https://reputecast.acme.io.
problem.logoUnreadable: The file couldn't be read. Upload an SVG or PNG.
problem.pngLarge: The PNG is larger than 512 KB. Use a smaller, square image.
problem.pngSize: Use a square PNG between 16 and 1024 pixels.
problem.svgLarge: The SVG is larger than 100 KB. Simplify it or upload a PNG.

problem.svgBad.message: The SVG contains {what, select, script {a script} html {embedded HTML} entity {an XML entity} iframe {an iframe} embed {embedded content} js {a javascript: link} other {something}}, which isn't allowed in a logo. Export it again as a plain image.

problem.svgLinks: The SVG contains event handlers or external links, which aren't allowed in a logo. Export it again as a plain image.
problem.svgXML: The SVG isn't well-formed XML. Export it again from your design tool.
problem.notSVG: The file isn't an SVG image. Upload an SVG or a square PNG.
problem.updateOff: The update check is off. Turn it on to fetch the latest release.
problem.deactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account. Ask another instance admin.

problem.soleOwner.message: {name} is the only Owner of {workspaces}. Transfer ownership first, then deactivate.
problem.soleOwner.note: workspaces: names joined as 'A, B and C'

problem.reason: Say why; the reason is recorded in the audit log.
problem.reasonRequired: A reason is required; it's recorded in the audit log.
problem.noTOTP: {name} has no authenticator app to reset.
problem.reauth: Sign in again with two-factor to reset someone's two-factor.

notice.deactivated.message: {name} is deactivated. Reactivate the account before sending a reset link.

problem.deactivatedFirst: {name} is deactivated. Reactivate the account first.

problem.noSystemProvider.message: No System-stream provider can send email yet. Run {command} on the server instead; it prints the same link.
problem.noSystemProvider.note: command: a command line, never translated

problem.resetUnsent.message: The reset email couldn't be sent ({error}). Nothing changed; use the CLI command instead.
problem.resetUnsent.note: error: the provider's answer, as it gave it

problem.lastAdmin: {name} is the last instance admin. Make someone else an instance admin first.
problem.workspaceName: Name the workspace, like Acme Engineering Blog.
problem.pickOwner: Pick an active account as the Owner.
problem.alreadyDeleted: {name} is already deleted. Restore it or wait for the purge.
problem.restoreExpired: {name} was deleted more than 7 days ago and can't be restored.
problem.idle: The idle timeout can't be longer than the session lifetime.

problem.ssoEnforces.message: {provider} enforces {domains}: turn enforcement off first, or {domains} accounts couldn't sign in at all.
problem.ssoEnforces.note: provider: an SSO provider's name; domains: acme.io, joined with commas

problem.noMethod: Keep at least one way to sign in turned on.
problem.lockout: This would leave you no way to sign in. Add a passkey or link a sign-in that stays on, then save again.

notify.twofaResetTitle.note: a notification to the person whose two-factor an admin reset

notify.twofaResetBody: {admin} reset two-factor on your account (reason: {reason}). Set up an authenticator app again before {at, date}.

notify.workspaceDeletedTitle.note: a notification to the members of a workspace an instance admin deleted

notify.workspaceDeletedSummary: {name} was deleted by an instance admin
notify.workspaceDeletedBody: An instance admin deleted {name}. It can be restored until {at, date}; after that it's gone for good.

audit.sessionsEnded.message: {count, plural, one {# session ended} other {# sessions ended}}

audit.keysRevoked: {count, plural, one {# API key revoked} other {# API keys revoked}}
audit.sendsStopped: {count, plural, one {# scheduled send stopped} other {# scheduled sends stopped}}
audit.purged: deleted for good after the 7-day restore hold
audit.updateOn: on: fetches the latest version number from github.com once a day
audit.updateOff: off: ReputeCast makes no outbound call on its own
audit.name: name {name}

section.methods.note: a section of Instance admin › Authentication, the audit entry's target

policy.passwordSignIn.note: an authentication policy change, in the audit log
